First, note the given date is 10-15-1834 (MM-DD-YYYY).  
Subtract 299 days:  

1834 is not a leap year (leap years are divisible by 4, but 1834/4 = 458.5).  
From Oct 15 back 15 days → Oct 1.  
From Oct 1 back 92 days (Sept: 30, Aug: 31, July: 31 → 92 days total) → July 1.  
So 15 + 92 = 107 days subtracted so far, remaining 299 − 107 = 192 days to go back from July 1, 1834.  

June 30 days, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 28, January 31 → sum from June back:  
30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 28 + 31 = 181 days (back to Jan 1, 1834).  
Remaining 192 − 181 = 11 days before Jan 1, 1834 → go into December 1833.  
Dec 31, 1833 minus 11 days = Dec 20, 1833.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1833-12-20
